headline: Bears Activate Kyler Gordon, Place Dayo Odeyingbo On IR
summary: Injuries have plagued Bears cornerback Kyler Gordon since 2025, but he is finally nearing his season debut. The Bears activated Gordon from the reserve/PUP list on Saturday, per a team announcement. In less encouraging news, the Bears placed defensive lineman Dayo Odeyingbo on injured reserve. He will miss at least four games. More to come…

headline: Commanders won't have Jacory Croskey-Merritt Monday night
summary: The Commanders will be without their top running back for Monday night's game against the 49ers.

headline: Steelers say DK Metcalf will play, Pat Freiermuth is questionable with calf injury
summary: Steelers wide receiver DK Metcalf is no longer on the injury report for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, but tight end Pat Freiermuth now is.
